provenance.method: Loaded and answered Ground screen at int8: one ordinary Load, then two Ground screen requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API. Mac in use (other jobs and downloads running). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

peakMemoryGB.basis: Load and two Ground screen requests on a 1024×1280 photo.

provenance.method: Sum of macOS phys_footprint_peak over all Arsenal worker processes (only the measured model was loaded) across one ordinary Load, then two Ground screen requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API; MiB converted to GB (10^9 bytes). Mac in use (other jobs and downloads running). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

secondsPerRequest.basis: One warm Ground screen request on a 1024×1280 photo.

provenance.method: Wall time of the timed (second) Ground screen request, one sample, after one ordinary Load, then two Ground screen requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API; includes the API round trip. Mac in use (other jobs and downloads running). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.
